{{Quote|It was him! I know it was him!”<br>”Pavan?”<br>”No. Not Pavan. The ''other''”<br>”The prodigy is a secondary target, Probus. We were specifically ordered to step up our search for Pavan and the droid.|Probus Tesla and Yral Chael|<ref name="CN3" />}}
'''Yral Chael''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] and a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] assigned him and fellow Inquisitor [[Mas Sirrah]] to Inquisitor [[Probus Tesla]] in order to capture [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and [[I-5YQ|I-Five]].<ref name="CN3" />

==Biography==
===Hunting Jax Pavan===
{{Quote|I've never seen them travel together like that.”<br>”That makes me feel so much better.|I-5YQ and Den Dhur upon seeing Sirrah, Chael and Tesla|<ref name="CN3" />}}
[[File:Coruscant Nights-Jedi Twilight.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Yral Chael, Mas Sirrah, and Probus Tesla hunted Jax Pavan and I-5YQ.]]
Yral Chael was an Imperial Inquisitor in the first year of the Galactic Empire. Following Probus Tesla’s fight with the Force prodigy [[Kajin Savaros]], Yral Chael alongside Mas Sirrah, was ordered to assist Tesla in his search for Jax Pavan and I-5YQ by Darth Vader. Tesla was the nominal leader of the trio, but Chael and Sirrah believed they should’ve been the leaders as Tesla had [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|failed]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kajin Savaros, a mere boy. Chael and Sirrah accompanied Tesla to the [[Ploughtekal Market]] where they inquired a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] proprietor about if they had seen this boy. Eventually one of the Inquisitors lowered their cowl and looked down the street. Then the Inquisitor said something, the three Inquisitors got agitated and then the trio walked off into a [[Turbolift/Legends|lift tube]]. When [[Den Dhur]] asked the proprietor about the Inquisitors, he speculated that the Inquisitors had [[Memory rub/Legends|wiped]] some of the Sullustan’s memory.<ref name="CN3" />

The trio continued until they came across the [[Snowblind Mews]], where Tesla [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] Kajin Savaros only for his presence to disappear. Sirrah and Chael failed to sense anything. Tesla expressed his frustration at Kajin’s presence disappearing, to which Chael reminded their nominal leader that Jax and I-Five were their main targets and Savaros a secondary. Tesla argued that there was reason to believe that Jax was with Savaros. When Sirrah asked how Tesla could know that, Probus explained that the boy's power could’ve drawn Jax like how it drew him and Jax would probably want to recruit the boy. Probus then ordered Sirrah and Chael to stay in the area while he made a report to Vader, Chael and Sirrah slipped into the shadows.<ref name="CN3" />

[[File:Den Dhur.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Den Dhur pretended to be a property agent to avoid the Inquisitors.]]
Shortly after, Den Dhur and I-Five tried to return to [[Poloda Place]] only for Den to spot one of the Inquisitors on a balcony. Den told his droid companion and they retraced their steps so they could buy a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[skinsuit]] for I-Five as a disguise. They returned half an hour later, Dhur playing the part of a property agent and I-Five a client. While they saw none of the Inquisitioners at first, they soon spotted one in the shade of an overhanging eave. However, they got back into Poloda Place without any problems.<ref name="CN3" />

Den and I-Five then came out shortly after with Kajin in the skinsuit, taking Kaj to an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] that [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] had arranged. They were trying to move Savaros to the now dead [[Ves Volette|Ves Volette’s]] old studio, so they could conceal his Force-sensitivivity with Volette’s [[Light sculpture|light sculptures]]. Den and Savaros spotted an Inquisitor roughly in the same position under the eave as Den saw him before. Kajin began to get nervous and started trying to take off his skinsuit, saying that he couldn’t fight with it on. Den tried to dissuade him while I-Five began to take off. The Inquisitor sensed Kaj’s distress and raised his hand toward the flying speeder, hesitated then reached again before swiveling his head. The Inquisitor dashed across the courtyard to the resiblock that held Poloda Place. He jumped onto the communal docking station, following the Force traces Jax Pavan was intentionally dropping to lure him away from Kajin. Jax made his way to the midlevels of the Ploughtekal Market but no Inquisitors surfaced.<ref name="CN3" />

Chael and his cohorts returned to the Snowblind Mews the following day. Rhinann spotted two or three of them, he wasn’t certain how many. He suggested to Jax Pavan over a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holo-proj]] that they abandon Poloda Place, which Jax agreed.<ref name="CN3" />

===Battle at Rainbow Parkway and death===
Two days later, [[Dejah Duare]] and Rhinann had taken Kajin Savaros to a small market in [[Rainbow Parkway]]. While walking down the street Dejah thought she saw the reflection of an Inquisitor in the canted window of a storefront. Kajin used the Force to probe the area for any Inquisitors and was about to assure Dejah it was nothing when he sensed two Inquisitors behind them, Chael and Sirrah, on the same street behind a corner and another Inquisitor, Probus Tesla, ahead of them, above and a half block away, but moving ever closer. Tesla was specifically seeking Kaj out, the boy realized. The Inquisitors felt Kajin's minute use of the Force. Kajin directed Dejah and Rhinann to a [[Cafe/Legends|cafe]] three doors down and ordered them to blend in with the crowd there. Rhinann bolted for the cafe before Kaj could finish, but Dejah protested. Savaros was soon able to convince her to go, telling her that he wouldn’t let them get close enough for her to use her telepathic abilities and pheromones. Once Dejah left, Kajin fell in pace beside a slow moving hovertruck. [[Laranth Tarak]], a [[Gray Paladin]], then stepped out of the cafe and fell in step beside the boy. Kaj explained that there were Inquisitors. Laranth replied she could sense them. Kaj told her there was one above them as well, when Probus dropped down from above. Kajin was astounded to see him as he thought he had killed the Inquisitor. The Paladin opened fire on Tesla with her [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] while Kajin released a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force blast]] that sent Probus back a dozen meters. Tesla’s changed position caused Tarak to miss and hit the cargo compartment of the hovertruck, bursting it into flames, Someone then screamed and the whole street burst into chaos.<ref name="CN3" />

[[File:Jax Pavan TERC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Yral Chael battled Jax Pavan at Rainbow Parkways.]]
Jax Pavan sensed the battle and went to the [[Gallery Row]] and saw that in Rainbow Parkway there were blasts of [[Force energy]] from multiple participants. [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]], who was visiting to speak with Jax and I-Five, took them to the [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|battle]] and offered to inform Imperials not to send back up as the Inquisitors had control of the situation. Jax and I-Five then left the prefect’s airspeeder and headed for the street. Chael and Sirrah prowled around Kajin’s [[Force barrier/Legends|Force shield]] that encased Kaj and Laranth. When the shield lowered, Kajin [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] up. Chael was quickly met by Jax’s [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. He was surprised to see Jax’s blade was [[Color/Legends|red]] like his own but it only lasted an instant. He parried Jax’s first stroke but leaned away from the attack as well and put himself at a disadvantage. Jax took advantage and pressed the attack, pushing Chael into the middle of the street in the same direction Laranth had ran after Sirrah. Jax’s attacks were tentative but he rejected his fear and doubted that Chael could do anything more unexpected or accomplished as [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] or [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] had in his fights with them. Jax feinted, meeting Chael’s [[Yral Chael's lightsaber|blade]] at the hilt, he continued the movement, sweeping down and charring Chael’s [[Robe/Legends|robes]]. Simultaneously, Jax leapt and used the two clashing blades as a fulcrum. Pavan somersaulted and landed on a far curb. He used this moment to try and spot Kajin but only saw the facade of the apothecary crumble and rain down debris narrowly missing Chael, who was charging at Jax. Jax spotted Probus Tesla’s strike of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Kajin. He then tried spotting Yral again. He saw a flutter of his scarlet robes among the raining debris but he had disappeared. Jax considered that Yral might have been taken out by the debris, but figured he didn’t as he was too resourceful. Jax dodged under the overhanging eaves of the building behind him and looked for Laranth who's Inquisitor adversary, Mas Sirrah had also disappeared. Jax spotted Sirrah leap from the debris at Laranth. Pavan then realized what Laranth was indicating to him, Chael on top of the [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] overhang was preparing to plunge his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through it and into Pavan’s head. Jax instantaneously dodged and shoved his own lightsaber through the overhang and raked it sideways with desperate strength. He heard a yell as he cut off Chael’s left leg from the knee down. Jax then somersaulted out from the overhang and rolled to his feet before then running to assist Tarak but was prepared to defend himself from above, which Chael did attack from. The dismembered Inquisitor let loose a current of Force lightning and leapt at Jax like a raptor with his lightsaber. Jax noted the move was shrewd as he could only block the lightning and was out of position to block Yral’s blade. Jax knew that if he jumped out of the way, Sirrah had a good chance of killing him. Jax dropped to his knees and hoped Chael couldn’t adjust his trajectory. Then he felt a tingle in the Force as a blue-white energy blast from I-Five and severed Chael’s sword arm at the shoulder. Chael landed several feet past Jax, with the Inquisitor's arm and lightsaber taking their own trajectory. I-Five then shot Yral in the throat, silencing his howls of pain and killing him.<ref name="CN3" />

==Personality and traits==
Yral Chael believed he should’ve been the leader of the Inquisitor trio consisting of him, Mas Sirrah and Probus Tesla instead of Tesla, as Tesla had failed to kill the teenage boy, Kajin Savaros.<ref name="CN3" />

Chael would remind Tesla that their main focus was to sniff out Jax Pavan and I-5YQ, rather to look for Savaros.<ref name="CN3" />

==Powers and abilities==
Yral Chael was a Force-sensitive human. Den Dhur speculated that Yral Chael, Mas Sirrah and Probus Tesla had wiped a Sullustan proprietor’s memory of parts of their inquiry. Yral was unable to sense Kajin Savaros’s breakdown while fellow Inquisitor Probus Tesla could. Chael was capable of wielding Force lightning.<ref name="CN3" />

Jax Pavan noted that Chael was resourceful and would make shrewd moves in combat. But Chael wasn’t a perfect swordsman, as displayed when he leaned back and parried one of Jax’s strikes, putting him at a disadvantage.<ref name="CN3" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Malorum.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Chael wore the scarlet robes of the Inquisitorius. (Robes pictured)]]
Yral Chael wore scarlet robes with a cowl, wore a cloak and wielded a red lightsaber. He also made use of a [[taozin amulet]] that hid his presence in the Force, making him appear as nothing.<ref name="CN3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yral Chael first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]].''<ref name="CN3" />

Once Yral Chael and Mas Sirrah join Probus Tesla in Patterns of Force, Den and I-Five begin to spot Inquisitors. It is not made clear which Inquisitors they see, whether it is Tesla, Chael or Sirrah. This article includes those sightings that Den and I-Five have, but keeps which ones they are ambiguous, such as the book.<ref name="CN3" />
